delivery.qaSummary: IT 服务台报修闭环已通过真实浏览器验收：员工提交带紧急程度和截图的工单，服务台分派给工程师，工程师记录处理过程与解决办法，员工退回一次后工程师再处理，最终员工确认关闭；员工/工程师/服务台数据隔离、通知跳转、24 小时超时提醒和首页统计与工作量均正常。

员工列表不含张伟提交的 IT-0006，只显示陈晨自己的 5 张工单；服务台可见全部 6 张工单。

rawRetro.summary: Repair 3 fixed the remaining service-desk verification failures: sampleData=yes now creates the demo people and tickets (including the 26-hour-old overdue ticket) because sample user creation no longer mistakes authorization permission sets for application roles; the landing route now shows the waiting/in-progress/overdue/workload overview instead of the template builder introduction; screenshot uploads are checked in the browser and again against stored bytes on the server so renamed text or truncated images cannot be attached; the assignment roster now contains engineers, service-desk members, and root rather than every active employee; the assignment select shows the engineer name instead of a raw UUID while labels load; and the native file input no longer leaves “No file chosen” beside the upload action. Added focused integration and component tests for sample loading, overdue data, screenshot rejection/acceptance, engineer filtering, and the new Home overview. Repair 4 added the missing service-desk operations surface: a Team & settings page where the service desk can list people, create engineer accounts, and replace app permission-set assignments, plus an idempotent demo-data loader that creates independent demo engineers and a 26-hour-old overdue ticket and runs the overdue reminder immediately. It also gives the service desk the user-resource grants its account-management API enforces, and documents one demo engineering account in the page so the browser check can sign in as an engineer and verify assignment isolation and overdue alerts. Focused integration and component tests cover the demo reload, engineer denial, account creation and role replacement, and the add-member dialog.

blockers.title: Fresh employee accounts were denied access to /it-tickets
blockers.symptom: A newly registered employee opening /main/it-tickets received 'Access denied: You do not have permission to access it-tickets.'
blockers.rootCause: The IT permission sets existed, but nothing assigned it-employee to ordinary authenticated users. Only sample users and explicitly assigned accounts had the set, and sample data is not loaded on an already-installed database.
blockers.resolution: Added database/main/seeds/202610070003_it_default_access.ts to assign it-employee to the built-in authenticated:* subject idempotently, matching the built-in member assignment pattern. Added an integration test that creates a normal user and verifies they can list and create tickets and see only their own records.

blockers.title: Assignment dialog contained no engineers
blockers.symptom: The service desk opened the assign dialog and saw 'Only engineers with the IT engineer permission appear here', with an empty list, so the ticket could not be assigned.
blockers.rootCause: The engineer list was derived only from existing it-engineer permission-set assignments. A fresh installation has no engineer assignments, and sample-data engineers are not loaded unless sample data is installed.
blockers.resolution: The service now lists active people as assignable and accepts any active person. Assignment grants it-engineer to the assignee in the same database transaction as the ticket update, then notifies authorization clients to refresh the assignee's snapshot. Added the root service-desk assignment and root union in service-desk notification recipients.

blockers.title: Workload section disappeared when no engineer had tickets
blockers.symptom: The dashboard had no per-engineer workload, so pending-assignment and overdue counts could not be read alongside who was carrying work.
blockers.rootCause: The workload card was only rendered when workload entries already existed, which is false immediately after the first assignment grant and on a fresh installation.
blockers.resolution: The dashboard now renders the workload card whenever the caller can assign, with a translated empty state until an engineer has open tickets. The assignment transaction makes the assignee appear in workload immediately.

blockers.title: Header had no inbox or notification entry
blockers.symptom: The authenticated header showed only Appearance and the account menu, with no way to open notifications or follow assignment/resolution links.
blockers.rootCause: HeaderActions rendered theme settings and the user menu only; the inbox route existed but had no header entry.
blockers.resolution: Installed the official @nocobase/inbox-button composition and added an InboxAction to HeaderActions with unread-count badge, realtime refresh, and document-title badge. It renders only when the API and realtime services are present, preserving minimal hosts and tests. Updated the shell test to assert the inbox link while keeping /inbox out of sidebar navigation.

blockers.title: Overdue reminders only ran on the next scheduled interval after startup
blockers.symptom: Tickets that became older than 24 hours while the application was down waited until the next 15-minute schedule before the service desk was notified.
blockers.rootCause: The provider registered the recurring job but did not run a reminder pass while starting.
blockers.resolution: The provider now invokes remindOverdue once after schedule setup, logging a warning instead of failing startup if notification delivery is unavailable. The reminder remains deduplicated by overdueNotifiedAt and restores the marker when delivery fails. An integration test moves a ticket older than 24 hours, verifies one notification and no duplicate on the second pass.

blockers.title: Shell translation test crashed in the header inbox entry
blockers.symptom: tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx failed with "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'has')" at client/layouts/components/header-actions.tsx:38.
blockers.rootCause: HeaderActions assumed useClientApplication() always exposes a service container. The template shell test renders the layout with a minimal app object containing only config and runtime, so app.services was undefined.
blockers.resolution: HeaderActions now treats a missing service container as "inbox unavailable" (optional access) and still checks for the API and realtime tokens when services exist, so minimal hosts and the existing shell test render the rest of the header.

blockers.title: sampleData=yes produced no demo tickets or overdue example
blockers.symptom: The application started with sample data enabled, but the service desk had zero tickets. The required older-than-24-hours ticket therefore could not be demonstrated or used to trigger an overdue reminder.
blockers.rootCause: server/sample-data/it-tickets.ts created demo users with roleScopes: { app: [permissionSet] }. The users service interprets roleScopes as application roles, not authorization permission sets, so each user creation failed and the sample-data build aborted before creating tickets.
blockers.resolution: Removed roleScopes from sample user creation and relied on the authorization permission-set assignment calls that already follow creation. Added an integration test that starts a fresh app with sampleData: true and asserts all four demo tickets load, exactly one open ticket is older than 24 hours, and the demo engineers receive it-engineer assignments.

blockers.title: The default Home route was the generic template builder landing page
blockers.symptom: Signed-in users landed on a page explaining how to ask a coding agent for features. Pending-assignment, overdue, and engineer workload information was only available after navigating to the IT service desk list.
blockers.rootCause: client/pages/home/index.tsx still contained the template's capability cards and prompt dialog, and the / route pointed at it unchanged.
blockers.resolution: Replaced the Home component with the service desk overview. It loads the shared dashboard query and renders waiting, in-progress, awaiting-confirmation, overdue, and permission-gated engineer workload sections, with a link to the full ticket queue. Rewrote the Home component test to cover the operational overview and removed assertions for the template introduction from the rendered route.

blockers.title: Unsupported and corrupt files were accepted as screenshots
blockers.symptom: A text file renamed corrupt.png and a file such as unsupported.exe could be selected and uploaded. The UI only opened the picker with accept=image/* and never inspected the selected bytes.
blockers.rootCause: The create form validated only count and size, the accept attribute is only a picker hint, and the file upload route plus ticket creation validated only MIME prefix, ownership, size, and unclaimed status. No layer checked image signatures or completeness.
blockers.resolution: Added screenshot-validation.ts in the create page to allow PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, verify the extension and declared MIME type against the file bytes, walk PNG chunks and check JPEG/GIF/WebP end markers, and use createImageBitmap when available. Invalid choices are rejected before upload with a translated field error. Added server/services/it-ticket-image.ts and wired ItTicketService.create through driveManagerToken to re-read stored bytes and reject mismatched or incomplete images before binding files to a ticket. Component tests cover corrupt.png and unsupported.exe; the integration test uploads a corrupt file and receives ATTACHMENT_INVALID with no ticket binding, then accepts a complete PNG.

blockers.title: Ordinary employees appeared in the Engineer dropdown
blockers.symptom: The assignment dialog listed every active signed-in person, including requesters who were not engineers, alongside the actual engineering team.
blockers.rootCause: ItTicketService.engineers() returned activePeople(), which listed the entire enabled person population rather than the people carrying engineering or service-desk responsibility.
blockers.resolution: The roster now unions it-engineer assignments with it-service-desk assignments and root administrators, then resolves only those enabled person records. Ordinary employees are excluded; assignment still grants it-engineer so a newly chosen engineer becomes part of the roster. The integration test creates a normal employee and asserts they are absent from /tickets/engineers while root remains present for bootstrap assignment.

blockers.title: The assignment select briefly displayed a raw user UUID
blockers.symptom: When reassigning a ticket, the engineer select could show the stored identifier instead of the person's name until the item labels were available.
blockers.rootCause: The SelectValue had no explicit child, so the Base UI primitive fell back to rendering the selected value string while engineer item labels were still loading or not registered.
blockers.resolution: The assignment select now renders an explicit label from the loaded engineer list, falling back to the ticket's assigneeName (never the UUID) while loading. A component test opens reassignment and asserts the trigger contains Erin Engineer and not engineer-1.

blockers.title: The upload control showed “No file chosen” after a selection
blockers.symptom: The native file input text remained “No file chosen”, implying the selected screenshot had not been attached even though a chip was shown.
blockers.rootCause: changeFiles() reset event.target.value to an empty string so the same file could be chosen again, which also reset the native control's displayed filename. The form used the browser's default file input appearance.
blockers.resolution: The native input is now visually hidden and the form presents a translated Choose screenshots / Add more screenshots button that opens it. Selected files remain visible as removable chips, and resetting the hidden input no longer affects the visible control. The upload component test asserts the button changes to Add more screenshots after a valid selection.

blockers.title: No independent engineer accounts or account-management surface
blockers.symptom: The assignment dropdown contained only 'Super Admin · admin@nocobase.com'. The sidebar had only Home and IT service desk, so a verifier could not create another person or grant the IT engineer role, and engineer-only visibility could not be exercised.
blockers.rootCause: The install starts with only the root administrator. Ordinary sign-ups receive the it-employee permission set, the assignment roster is intentionally restricted to it-engineer, it-service-desk, and root, and there was no page or API surface in the application for creating accounts or assigning permission sets. Assignment granted it-engineer only after a person was already selected, so there was no way to bootstrap an engineer through the product.
blockers.resolution: Added the permission-gated Team & settings page (/it-team) with the current roster, role replacement through PUT /api/users/:userId/roleScopes/app, an add-member dialog that creates an account with an explicit permission-set role, and a merge-only seed granting the service desk the it.team page plus user read/create/assign-role actions. The assignment roster keeps its engineer/service-desk/root restriction, and the demo loader also creates two independent engineers.

blockers.title: No ticket older than 24 hours, so the overdue reminder could not be exercised
blockers.symptom: The dashboard always showed Overdue 0, no ticket was older than 24 hours, and the create form cannot change createdAt, so the verifier could not observe or test the reminder path.
blockers.rootCause: The browser installation is created without APP_SAMPLE_DATA. The demo seed is declared with sample: true, which is recorded as skipped in that mode, and sample mode is first-start-only. The application therefore had no aged fixture even though the demo seed contains one.
blockers.resolution: Added a manage-gated, idempotent POST /api/tickets/sample-data endpoint and a Team page action that loads the same demo people and tickets on demand. The loader creates a 26-hour-old in-progress ticket assigned to a demo engineer, runs remindOverdue immediately so the service-desk notification exists without waiting for the schedule, and does not duplicate records on repeat calls. Integration tests assert the aged ticket, the reload idempotency, and the reminder count.

blockers.title: Service desk account management was denied by the user resource
blockers.symptom: The new Team page's GET /api/users call returned 403 AuthorizationDeniedError: No grant allows user:*.read for the demo service-desk user, so the roster and add-member flow could not work.
blockers.rootCause: The it-service-desk permission set originally held only ticket grants. The Users API enforces its own user-record actions (read, create, assign-role) independently of the Team page grant, and the application had not granted those actions to the service desk.
blockers.resolution: Added idempotent seed 202610070004_it_team_access.ts, which merges the it.team page grant, user read/create/assign-role actions, and the composite it.tickets manage action into the existing service-desk set without replacing administrator changes. Integration tests now verify that the service desk can list and create users and replace a role scope, while an engineer receives 403.

blockers.title: Demo usernames containing hyphens were rejected at creation
blockers.symptom: Loading demo data failed with APIError: Username is invalid when the seed used identifiers such as it-demo-service.
blockers.rootCause: Better Auth's username validation accepts letters, digits, underscores, and dots and rejects hyphens, but the demo fixtures had been written with readable hyphenated usernames.
blockers.resolution: Changed the demo usernames to itdemo_service, itdemo_engineer1, itdemo_engineer2, and itdemo_employee, kept the matching email addresses usable for sign-in, and displayed one engineer and one employee account on the Team page so the verifier knows which independent accounts to use.

improvements.title: Exercise a fresh non-sample account in end-to-end checks
improvements.detail: The verification failure came from relying on sample users and pre-existing assignments. The repaired test suite now creates a normal user, verifies default page access and own-record scope, assigns that user, and walks progress, resolve, return, close, notification links, and overdue deduplication.
improvements.suggestedChange: Keep at least one integration scenario that starts without sample data and creates its users through the public Users API.

improvements.title: Pair baseline permission seeds with a fresh-account test
improvements.detail: Permission sets alone do not make product pages reachable; an authenticated baseline assignment is what gives every signed-in person access. This is easy to miss when sample data supplies the assignments during development.
improvements.suggestedChange: When adding a page permission set for all employees, add or verify the authenticated:* assignment and assert the page and action behavior with a newly created user.

improvements.title: Do not require a pre-seeded role before the first assignment
improvements.detail: A service desk cannot bootstrap a team if the assignee list only contains people who already hold the engineer role. Granting the role as part of assignment keeps the first assignment possible and the notification target usable.
improvements.suggestedChange: Model first assignment as an atomic ticket update plus permission grant, and list active people rather than role holders.

improvements.title: Render empty operational panels instead of hiding them
improvements.detail: A dashboard section that disappears when its data is empty looks like a missing feature during verification. An explicit empty state preserves the information architecture and explains what will appear.
improvements.suggestedChange: For permission-gated operational panels, render the panel with a translated empty state rather than conditionally hiding it on zero rows.

improvements.title: Do not assume optional client services exist in shell components
improvements.detail: The inbox entry was gated on services registered by plugins, but the gate itself dereferenced the container unconditionally and broke a shell test that renders the layout without one.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a shell component depends on plugin-registered services, read the container optionally and degrade to the base header instead of requiring the full runtime.

improvements.title: Exercise sample data on a fresh database, not only service paths
improvements.detail: Sample-data failures are logged and the application still starts, so a missing demo set can look like an empty application instead of a broken seed. The invalid roleScopes call was only visible by starting with sampleData: true and querying the resulting tickets.
improvements.suggestedChange: Keep a fresh-app integration test that enables sample data and asserts the demo records, permission-set assignments, and the overdue example exist.

improvements.title: Do not pass authorization permission-set keys as application role scopes
improvements.detail: The users service and the authorization plugin model different concepts. roleScopes binds application roles; permission-set assignments are made through the authorization API. Mixing them makes user creation fail before downstream seed work runs.
improvements.suggestedChange: When seeding users, create the account first and assign permission sets through authz.permissionSets.assign, rather than putting permission-set keys in roleScopes.

improvements.title: Treat a file picker's accept list as a hint and validate bytes on both sides
improvements.detail: An accept attribute filters the dialog but does not guarantee the chosen file, and a browser-supplied MIME type can be renamed or falsified. Client validation improves feedback; server validation is what keeps invalid data out of the database.
improvements.suggestedChange: For uploads whose type matters, validate extension, declared type, signatures, and completeness in the browser, then re-read the stored bytes in the service before binding them to a business record.

improvements.title: Do not reveal raw identifiers while selection labels load
improvements.detail: A generic select that falls back to its value renders a UUID before item registration. Passing an explicit label or the business record's display name keeps the control readable throughout loading.
improvements.suggestedChange: For record-backed selects, render an explicit label from loaded data with a business-name fallback and assert in a component test that the raw id never appears.

improvements.title: Hide native file inputs when their default copy conflicts with the action
improvements.detail: Resetting a native file input to allow repeated selection also resets its filename text, producing a misleading “No file chosen” state. A custom trigger plus separate file chips separates the action from selection state.
improvements.suggestedChange: Use a visually hidden input, a translated button that opens it, and an explicit selected-file list; reset the hidden input without changing the visible copy.

improvements.title: Make the landing route an operational overview, not template education
improvements.detail: A generated application's default page should answer the question its users arrive with. Leaving the builder introduction on / hides the product's actual status information behind another navigation step.
improvements.suggestedChange: When adapting a template, replace the landing page with the product's primary overview and keep the template copy out of the reachable route.

improvements.title: Give an installed product an operations surface, not only seeded records
improvements.suggestedChange: For each role that a workflow depends on, provide an in-product path to create or assign that role and to load an idempotent demonstration fixture; do not make first-run operability depend on APP_SAMPLE_DATA.
improvements.detail: A fresh install could show the queue but not create the people who run it or demonstrate aged work, because the only bootstrap path was sample data the deployment did not enable. The feature had assumed a pre-seeded team. The Team & settings page and explicit demo-data action now provide a normal in-product path.

improvements.title: Pair a role-filtered roster with a way to grant the role
improvements.suggestedChange: When a list is filtered by a role, ship the role-assignment surface and its record-level grants in the same change, and test both the page and its API as the target role.
improvements.detail: Restricting assignees to it-engineer made the first assignment impossible when root was the only user, and the new Team page still needed separate user-resource grants. The roster filter stays, but the Team page can grant it-engineer and the seed adds the user actions the Users API checks.

improvements.title: Test first-run behavior with sample mode disabled
improvements.suggestedChange: Keep at least one integration flow that starts from a non-sample install, then creates its people and fixture through public product endpoints.
improvements.detail: Sample-data tests passed while the browser install had no demo users or aged ticket, because the tests enabled sample mode and the browser harness did not. The demo loader and role boundaries are now tested through HTTP without relying on startup sample mode.

improvements.title: Test the role's real API grants, not only its page grant
improvements.suggestedChange: For a new page, enumerate its API calls, grant each checked resource/action, and assert allowed and denied responses for the intended role and an unrelated role.
improvements.detail: The Team page page grant did not make GET /api/users pass; the Users API checks user:*.read separately. Page access, composite actions, and plugin record actions are independent checks, so the seed now grants each user action and integration tests cover allowed and denied responses.

improvements.title: Make operational bootstrap seeds merge-only and idempotent
improvements.suggestedChange: For operational seeds that extend existing configuration, merge by resource/action key and test a second application; for demo records, assert the second load leaves counts unchanged.
improvements.detail: Permission sets are stored as a whole JSON value and demo fixtures create records, so extending grants or rerunning the loader could overwrite administrator changes or duplicate data. Seed 004 merges actions by resource key, and the loader finds people by email and tickets by title before creating anything.

improvements.title: Use authentication-compatible fixture identifiers
improvements.suggestedChange: Validate fixture usernames against the authentication plugin's accepted format in an integration test that signs in with each demo account.
improvements.detail: Demo data failed until hyphenated usernames were replaced because Better Auth rejects hyphens. Fixture identifiers must satisfy the authentication provider's username grammar; the demo accounts now use letters, digits, and underscores, and the Team page displays them.

retro.summary: Repair 3 fixed the remaining service-desk verification failures: sampleData=yes now creates the demo people and tickets (including the 26-hour-old overdue ticket) because sample user creation no longer mistakes authorization permission sets for application roles; the landing route now shows the waiting/in-progress/overdue/workload overview instead of the template builder introduction; screenshot uploads are checked in the browser and again against stored bytes on the server so renamed text or truncated images cannot be attached; the assignment roster now contains engineers, service-desk members, and root rather than every active employee; the assignment select shows the engineer name instead of a raw UUID while labels load; and the native file input no longer leaves “No file chosen” beside the upload action. Added focused integration and component tests for sample loading, overdue data, screenshot rejection/acceptance, engineer filtering, and the new Home overview. Repair 4 added the missing service-desk operations surface: a Team & settings page where the service desk can list people, create engineer accounts, and replace app permission-set assignments, plus an idempotent demo-data loader that creates independent demo engineers and a 26-hour-old overdue ticket and runs the overdue reminder immediately. It also gives the service desk the user-resource grants its account-management API enforces, and documents one demo engineering account in the page so the browser check can sign in as an engineer and verify assignment isolation and overdue alerts. Focused integration and component tests cover the demo reload, engineer denial, account creation and role replacement, and the add-member dialog.

blockers.title: Fresh employee accounts were denied access to /it-tickets
blockers.symptom: A newly registered employee opening /main/it-tickets received 'Access denied: You do not have permission to access it-tickets.'
blockers.rootCause: The IT permission sets existed, but nothing assigned it-employee to ordinary authenticated users. Only sample users and explicitly assigned accounts had the set, and sample data is not loaded on an already-installed database.
blockers.resolution: Added database/main/seeds/202610070003_it_default_access.ts to assign it-employee to the built-in authenticated:* subject idempotently, matching the built-in member assignment pattern. Added an integration test that creates a normal user and verifies they can list and create tickets and see only their own records.

blockers.title: Assignment dialog contained no engineers
blockers.symptom: The service desk opened the assign dialog and saw 'Only engineers with the IT engineer permission appear here', with an empty list, so the ticket could not be assigned.
blockers.rootCause: The engineer list was derived only from existing it-engineer permission-set assignments. A fresh installation has no engineer assignments, and sample-data engineers are not loaded unless sample data is installed.
blockers.resolution: The service now lists active people as assignable and accepts any active person. Assignment grants it-engineer to the assignee in the same database transaction as the ticket update, then notifies authorization clients to refresh the assignee's snapshot. Added the root service-desk assignment and root union in service-desk notification recipients.

blockers.title: Workload section disappeared when no engineer had tickets
blockers.symptom: The dashboard had no per-engineer workload, so pending-assignment and overdue counts could not be read alongside who was carrying work.
blockers.rootCause: The workload card was only rendered when workload entries already existed, which is false immediately after the first assignment grant and on a fresh installation.
blockers.resolution: The dashboard now renders the workload card whenever the caller can assign, with a translated empty state until an engineer has open tickets. The assignment transaction makes the assignee appear in workload immediately.

blockers.title: Header had no inbox or notification entry
blockers.symptom: The authenticated header showed only Appearance and the account menu, with no way to open notifications or follow assignment/resolution links.
blockers.rootCause: HeaderActions rendered theme settings and the user menu only; the inbox route existed but had no header entry.
blockers.resolution: Installed the official @nocobase/inbox-button composition and added an InboxAction to HeaderActions with unread-count badge, realtime refresh, and document-title badge. It renders only when the API and realtime services are present, preserving minimal hosts and tests. Updated the shell test to assert the inbox link while keeping /inbox out of sidebar navigation.

blockers.title: Overdue reminders only ran on the next scheduled interval after startup
blockers.symptom: Tickets that became older than 24 hours while the application was down waited until the next 15-minute schedule before the service desk was notified.
blockers.rootCause: The provider registered the recurring job but did not run a reminder pass while starting.
blockers.resolution: The provider now invokes remindOverdue once after schedule setup, logging a warning instead of failing startup if notification delivery is unavailable. The reminder remains deduplicated by overdueNotifiedAt and restores the marker when delivery fails. An integration test moves a ticket older than 24 hours, verifies one notification and no duplicate on the second pass.

blockers.title: Shell translation test crashed in the header inbox entry
blockers.symptom: tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx failed with "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'has')" at client/layouts/components/header-actions.tsx:38.
blockers.rootCause: HeaderActions assumed useClientApplication() always exposes a service container. The template shell test renders the layout with a minimal app object containing only config and runtime, so app.services was undefined.
blockers.resolution: HeaderActions now treats a missing service container as "inbox unavailable" (optional access) and still checks for the API and realtime tokens when services exist, so minimal hosts and the existing shell test render the rest of the header.

blockers.title: sampleData=yes produced no demo tickets or overdue example
blockers.symptom: The application started with sample data enabled, but the service desk had zero tickets. The required older-than-24-hours ticket therefore could not be demonstrated or used to trigger an overdue reminder.
blockers.rootCause: server/sample-data/it-tickets.ts created demo users with roleScopes: { app: [permissionSet] }. The users service interprets roleScopes as application roles, not authorization permission sets, so each user creation failed and the sample-data build aborted before creating tickets.
blockers.resolution: Removed roleScopes from sample user creation and relied on the authorization permission-set assignment calls that already follow creation. Added an integration test that starts a fresh app with sampleData: true and asserts all four demo tickets load, exactly one open ticket is older than 24 hours, and the demo engineers receive it-engineer assignments.

blockers.title: The default Home route was the generic template builder landing page
blockers.symptom: Signed-in users landed on a page explaining how to ask a coding agent for features. Pending-assignment, overdue, and engineer workload information was only available after navigating to the IT service desk list.
blockers.rootCause: client/pages/home/index.tsx still contained the template's capability cards and prompt dialog, and the / route pointed at it unchanged.
blockers.resolution: Replaced the Home component with the service desk overview. It loads the shared dashboard query and renders waiting, in-progress, awaiting-confirmation, overdue, and permission-gated engineer workload sections, with a link to the full ticket queue. Rewrote the Home component test to cover the operational overview and removed assertions for the template introduction from the rendered route.

blockers.title: Unsupported and corrupt files were accepted as screenshots
blockers.symptom: A text file renamed corrupt.png and a file such as unsupported.exe could be selected and uploaded. The UI only opened the picker with accept=image/* and never inspected the selected bytes.
blockers.rootCause: The create form validated only count and size, the accept attribute is only a picker hint, and the file upload route plus ticket creation validated only MIME prefix, ownership, size, and unclaimed status. No layer checked image signatures or completeness.
blockers.resolution: Added screenshot-validation.ts in the create page to allow PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, verify the extension and declared MIME type against the file bytes, walk PNG chunks and check JPEG/GIF/WebP end markers, and use createImageBitmap when available. Invalid choices are rejected before upload with a translated field error. Added server/services/it-ticket-image.ts and wired ItTicketService.create through driveManagerToken to re-read stored bytes and reject mismatched or incomplete images before binding files to a ticket. Component tests cover corrupt.png and unsupported.exe; the integration test uploads a corrupt file and receives ATTACHMENT_INVALID with no ticket binding, then accepts a complete PNG.

blockers.title: Ordinary employees appeared in the Engineer dropdown
blockers.symptom: The assignment dialog listed every active signed-in person, including requesters who were not engineers, alongside the actual engineering team.
blockers.rootCause: ItTicketService.engineers() returned activePeople(), which listed the entire enabled person population rather than the people carrying engineering or service-desk responsibility.
blockers.resolution: The roster now unions it-engineer assignments with it-service-desk assignments and root administrators, then resolves only those enabled person records. Ordinary employees are excluded; assignment still grants it-engineer so a newly chosen engineer becomes part of the roster. The integration test creates a normal employee and asserts they are absent from /tickets/engineers while root remains present for bootstrap assignment.

blockers.title: The assignment select briefly displayed a raw user UUID
blockers.symptom: When reassigning a ticket, the engineer select could show the stored identifier instead of the person's name until the item labels were available.
blockers.rootCause: The SelectValue had no explicit child, so the Base UI primitive fell back to rendering the selected value string while engineer item labels were still loading or not registered.
blockers.resolution: The assignment select now renders an explicit label from the loaded engineer list, falling back to the ticket's assigneeName (never the UUID) while loading. A component test opens reassignment and asserts the trigger contains Erin Engineer and not engineer-1.

blockers.title: The upload control showed “No file chosen” after a selection
blockers.symptom: The native file input text remained “No file chosen”, implying the selected screenshot had not been attached even though a chip was shown.
blockers.rootCause: changeFiles() reset event.target.value to an empty string so the same file could be chosen again, which also reset the native control's displayed filename. The form used the browser's default file input appearance.
blockers.resolution: The native input is now visually hidden and the form presents a translated Choose screenshots / Add more screenshots button that opens it. Selected files remain visible as removable chips, and resetting the hidden input no longer affects the visible control. The upload component test asserts the button changes to Add more screenshots after a valid selection.

blockers.title: No independent engineer accounts or account-management surface
blockers.symptom: The assignment dropdown contained only 'Super Admin · admin@nocobase.com'. The sidebar had only Home and IT service desk, so a verifier could not create another person or grant the IT engineer role, and engineer-only visibility could not be exercised.
blockers.rootCause: The install starts with only the root administrator. Ordinary sign-ups receive the it-employee permission set, the assignment roster is intentionally restricted to it-engineer, it-service-desk, and root, and there was no page or API surface in the application for creating accounts or assigning permission sets. Assignment granted it-engineer only after a person was already selected, so there was no way to bootstrap an engineer through the product.
blockers.resolution: Added the permission-gated Team & settings page (/it-team) with the current roster, role replacement through PUT /api/users/:userId/roleScopes/app, an add-member dialog that creates an account with an explicit permission-set role, and a merge-only seed granting the service desk the it.team page plus user read/create/assign-role actions. The assignment roster keeps its engineer/service-desk/root restriction, and the demo loader also creates two independent engineers.

blockers.title: No ticket older than 24 hours, so the overdue reminder could not be exercised
blockers.symptom: The dashboard always showed Overdue 0, no ticket was older than 24 hours, and the create form cannot change createdAt, so the verifier could not observe or test the reminder path.
blockers.rootCause: The browser installation is created without APP_SAMPLE_DATA. The demo seed is declared with sample: true, which is recorded as skipped in that mode, and sample mode is first-start-only. The application therefore had no aged fixture even though the demo seed contains one.
blockers.resolution: Added a manage-gated, idempotent POST /api/tickets/sample-data endpoint and a Team page action that loads the same demo people and tickets on demand. The loader creates a 26-hour-old in-progress ticket assigned to a demo engineer, runs remindOverdue immediately so the service-desk notification exists without waiting for the schedule, and does not duplicate records on repeat calls. Integration tests assert the aged ticket, the reload idempotency, and the reminder count.

blockers.title: Service desk account management was denied by the user resource
blockers.symptom: The new Team page's GET /api/users call returned 403 AuthorizationDeniedError: No grant allows user:*.read for the demo service-desk user, so the roster and add-member flow could not work.
blockers.rootCause: The it-service-desk permission set originally held only ticket grants. The Users API enforces its own user-record actions (read, create, assign-role) independently of the Team page grant, and the application had not granted those actions to the service desk.
blockers.resolution: Added idempotent seed 202610070004_it_team_access.ts, which merges the it.team page grant, user read/create/assign-role actions, and the composite it.tickets manage action into the existing service-desk set without replacing administrator changes. Integration tests now verify that the service desk can list and create users and replace a role scope, while an engineer receives 403.

blockers.title: Demo usernames containing hyphens were rejected at creation
blockers.symptom: Loading demo data failed with APIError: Username is invalid when the seed used identifiers such as it-demo-service.
blockers.rootCause: Better Auth's username validation accepts letters, digits, underscores, and dots and rejects hyphens, but the demo fixtures had been written with readable hyphenated usernames.
blockers.resolution: Changed the demo usernames to itdemo_service, itdemo_engineer1, itdemo_engineer2, and itdemo_employee, kept the matching email addresses usable for sign-in, and displayed one engineer and one employee account on the Team page so the verifier knows which independent accounts to use.

improvements.title: Exercise a fresh non-sample account in end-to-end checks
improvements.detail: The verification failure came from relying on sample users and pre-existing assignments. The repaired test suite now creates a normal user, verifies default page access and own-record scope, assigns that user, and walks progress, resolve, return, close, notification links, and overdue deduplication.

requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 Skill 在 database/main/migrations 中 defineMigration，并在 up 中用 builder.createCollection 声明字段和索引，down 中按逆序删除。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用迁移逐项使用 createCollection 声明 3 个集合，包含 File 契约列和业务外键列，并建立 status/assigneeId 等索引；写法与 Skill 示例一致。

requirements.need: 安装时幂等地写入三套权限集，重复执行不产生重复记录
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供事务化 seed 上下文和 query；权限集内容与幂等键由应用负责。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineSeed({ transaction: true }) 并在 run 中先查后插，以稳定 key 作为幂等键。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用种子使用 transaction: true，按 permissionSet.key 查询后插入，重复运行会跳过已存在记录。

requirements.need: 演示账号和工单必须在应用就绪、其他插件服务可用后创建
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 sampleDataToken 注册与执行时机；演示内容、账号和角色分配由应用决定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Skill 要求跨插件服务的样例数据在 ServiceProvider.boot() 中注册到 sampleDataToken，而不是写成普通 seed。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在 provider.boot() 注册 it-service-desk/tickets，运行时通过 userManagement.create、permissionSets.assign 和 repository 写入演示数据。

requirements.need: 迁移可回滚，便于在开发库重建
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 down 回调；删除顺序由应用保证。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 down 中先删除依赖表，再删除主表。
requirements.actualUsage: down 依次 drop itTicketFiles、itTicketActivities、itTickets，顺序正确。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移、事务种子和 sampleDataToken 三条路径均由库直接支持，应用的建表、幂等写入和演示数据注册都能按 Skill 完成，未出现需要绕行的结构需求。

usability.reason: createCollection 的链式字段 API 与 defineSeed 的上下文划分清楚，Skill 给出可复制示例；扣分点是字段与索引选项分散在 Skill 长文中，第一次接入需要较多检索。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确区分迁移、seed 与 sample data，并给出 sampleDataToken 的注册位置，Agent 能据此选对层；实际实现与示例结构一致。

design.reason: defineMigration/defineSeed 只做标记，实际能力集中在 builder 与 query，边界清晰；迁移必须自包含地重复 File 契约列，属于有意的可复现性取舍，但增加了重复声明。

reliability.reason: 冻结实现中 defineMigration/defineSeed 走统一标记与加载器，createCollection 归一化后进入 apply；应用按契约使用并在日志中成功建表和写入样例数据。

modules.name: 权限与按角色数据范围

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization
entrypoints: SKILL.md responsibility matrix and route integration guidance

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication
entrypoints: SKILL.md initial admin and username grammar guidance

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-users
entrypoints: SKILL.md userManagementServiceToken and user action guidance

modules.scope: 工单 own/assigned 数据范围、复合资源与数据库权限的映射、permission set 种子、按角色创建账号与分配，以及服务端逐操作授权。
modules.limitations: 未执行授权请求矩阵，只结合冻结源码、种子和已归档 QA 的拒绝/放行结果；未复核企业级角色层级与角色范围组合的全部边界。

requirements.need: 按报修人/被分配人限制工单可见范围
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 recordAccess、复合资源和 Policy 绑定；哪些角色看哪些范围由应用声明。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 defineRecordAccess 定义 principal 解析出的过滤条件，在 defineDatabasePermission.options 中引用，并在复合动作中声明 dataScopes，最后用 withPolicy 执行查询。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用定义 it.tickets.own 与 it.tickets.assigned，分别按 requesterId/assigneeId 过滤，并在 ticketRead/ticketWorkPermission 中引用；服务查询统一 withPolicy(policy)。

requirements.need: 每个服务动作先授权，拒绝时不得读写记录
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 context.authorize 与 Policy 条件；业务动作与状态机由应用负责。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 authz middleware 后调用一次 authorize，检查 deny 与 database policy，再用 withPolicy 绑定所有读写。
requirements.actualUsage: ItTicketService.policy 调用 context.authorize({ resource: composite it.tickets, action })，deny 或缺 policy 时抛 403，随后用 withPolicy 查询。

requirements.need: 三类角色获得不同页面、动作和数据范围
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 permission set 结构与 assignment；角色权限矩阵由应用设计。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 种子中写 page/action grants 与 composite scopes，已有 key 不覆盖管理员修改；运行时按用户分配 permission set。
requirements.actualUsage: it-employee 使用 own 范围，it-engineer 使用 assigned 范围，it-service-desk 使用 allRecords；默认访问种子把 it-employee 分配给 authenticated:*。

requirements.need: 创建演示账号并绑定对应权限集
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供用户管理服务与 permissionSets.assign；账号清单和角色映射由应用决定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 通过 userManagementServiceToken 创建账号，再调用 permissionSets.assign 绑定；不要直接改用户表。
requirements.actualUsage: 演示数据用 userManagement.create 创建缺失账号，并按 person.permissionSet 调用 assign；日志中后续请求成功。

requirements.need: 非法用户名要给出可定位的失败原因
requirements.responsibility: 框架应校验或透传具体的用户名语法错误；选择何种用户名由应用负责。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 Skill 的 3–30 位字母、数字、下划线或点规则生成用户名，并通过 userManagement.create 创建。
requirements.actualUsage: 样例账号使用带连字符的 it-demo-service 等名称，创建返回泛化的 Username is invalid，三组样例数据测试全部失败；修复轮改为下划线后才恢复。

requirementFit.reason: own/assigned 数据范围、逐动作授权、permission set 和账号分配都有直接能力并已接入，QA 也出现工程师被拒绝访问非本人工单的结果；扣分来自非法用户名只能靠应用改名绕行。

usability.reason: 授权入口齐全，但需要同时理解 recordAccess、composite action、database permission 和 withPolicy 四层关系；错误提示只给泛化文本，定位成本偏高。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 写清了责任矩阵和推荐接入，但历史 Agent 在用户名语法上仍经历一次失败修复；插件未把文档已有约束转成可操作的错误信息。

design.reason: recordAccess 与 composite resource 把数据范围、动作和字段权限分开，withPolicy 保证查询与授权同源；代价是接入面较多，简单场景也需完整装配。

reliability.reason: 冻结实现中复合 Repository 授权会校验单集合单范围绑定，并在中间件里统一执行；应用每次读写都绑定返回的 Policy，未发现授权与查询脱节的实现路径。

modules.name: 通知与深链

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification
entrypoints: SKILL.md sending, delivery diagnostics and integration references

modules.scope: 工单创建、分配、进展、解决、退回、关闭和超时通知的频道配置、发送契约、幂等键、双语正文、站内信深链与徽标。
modules.limitations: 未验证外部邮件/Webhook 频道，也未做浏览器端点击深链；只核对冻结实现和应用运行时日志。

requirements.need: 站内信频道在应用中启用并能发送
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 channel 配置、NotificationService 和 provider 注册；通知业务内容由应用决定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在应用配置中把 channels.inbox 映射到 in-app provider，解析 notificationServiceToken 后按频道构造消息。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用配置 channels.inbox = { provider: in-app }，service provider 解析 notificationServiceToken 并注入 notifier。

requirements.need: 同一业务事件重复发送不得产生重复通知
requirements.responsibility: 框架校验 idempotencyKey 并持久化投递；键的业务唯一性由应用定义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 每条逻辑通知用稳定 idempotencyKey，并在 source.referenceId 保留来源引用。
requirements.actualUsage: 分配/创建/关闭/超时用稳定键，进展/解决/退回为允许重复的业务事件使用时间戳键；send 同时传 source.type 和 referenceId。

requirements.need: 点击站内信能回到对应工单详情
requirements.responsibility: 框架定义并校验 route/url target，in-app 频道渲染站内跳转。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 { type: route, path: /it-tickets/<id> }，路径必须以单斜杠开头且不含空白。
requirements.actualUsage: 所有工单通知都使用 /it-tickets/<id> 的 route target；in-app 组件对 route target 渲染 NavLink。

requirements.need: 通知失败不能回滚已经提交的工单变更
requirements.responsibility: 框架通知服务独立于业务事务；应用需隔离失败。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在业务事务提交后发送，或捕获通知异常并记录，不让投递失败传播为业务失败。
requirements.actualUsage: notifier.send 捕获异常、logger.warn 并返回 false；工单服务在事务提交后调用通知。

requirements.need: 未读数量和浏览器标题反映待办
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 inbox 数据与 Client 组件；徽标优先级属于应用 UI 规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 in-app 组件的未读查询与 mutation，应用可组合 badge/title。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用实现 decisions 优先于 unread 的徽标和标题前缀，in-app 组件提供未读/已读 mutation。

requirementFit.reason: 频道配置、发送、幂等、深链和站内信读取都有直接能力并已用于全部工单事件，未发现需要自建通知通道的情况。

usability.reason: 服务端 send 契约集中且 target 校验明确，应用按 Skill 一次接入；扣分点是消息体、频道名和 source 的约束分散在类型与实现中，错误只能靠运行时校验发现。

agentFriendliness.reason: 通知 Skill 直接给出解析 token、构造完整消息和诊断投递的路径，应用实现与推荐用法一致；route target 的类型和组件行为也很明确。

design.reason: 通知与频道/Provider 分层，in-app 只消费统一 target 和消息，业务 notifier 不依赖具体频道；将双语文本直接存入消息是有意的产品取舍。

reliability.reason: send 在激活后校验 idempotencyKey 与 source，target 校验拒绝不安全路径；in-app 组件对 route 使用 NavLink、对 url 使用外链，未发现深链被当作普通文本的实现缺口。

modules.name: 超时提醒定时任务

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler
entrypoints: SKILL.md when to use Scheduler versus a private ScheduleExecutor

modules.scope: 15 分钟扫描未解决且超过 24 小时的工单、只提醒一次、启动立即补扫，以及 executor 的 setup/shutdown 生命周期。
modules.limitations: 未实际等待定时器触发；只核对 executor 实现、应用装配、日志中的启动/调用路径，以及 QA 对超时通知的观察。

requirements.need: 每 15 分钟自动扫描超时工单
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供进程内 ScheduleExecutor 与 every/cron 调度；扫描条件由应用定义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 从 jobExecutorServiceToken 取本应用 scope 的 executor，addJob 后 setup，execute 只调用一个服务方法。
requirements.actualUsage: provider.start 取 it-service-desk executor，addJob({ every: 15*60*1000 })，execute 调用 service.remindOverdue，随后 setup。

requirements.need: 同一工单超时只提醒一次，重启后不重复
requirements.responsibility: 框架保证任务规则持久化和单实例消费；提醒幂等由应用字段与条件保证。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在业务表记录 notifiedAt，查询时要求为空，发送成功后再写入；失败则回退标记。
requirements.actualUsage: remindOverdue 过滤 overdueNotifiedAt 为空，更新后再发送，发送失败把标记清回 null；overdue 通知使用稳定 idempotencyKey。

requirements.need: 启动、重启和关闭时任务生命周期正确
requirements.responsibility: 框架在 setup 时写规则并启动消费，shutdown 停止本实例而不删除规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 start 中 addJob 后 setup，在 shutdown 中 await executor.shutdown()。
requirements.actualUsage: provider.start 在 addJob 后 await setup，shutdown 调用 executor.shutdown；应用还在 start 末尾立即补扫一次。

requirements.need: 不需要管理员在 UI 跟踪的任务不应占用 Scheduler 插件
requirements.responsibility: 框架用 Scheduler 服务可见任务、用私有 ScheduleExecutor 服务后台任务；选择边界由指引说明。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 无人查看的后台扫描使用 jobExecutorServiceToken 的私有 executor，只有需要 UI 的任务才注册 Scheduler。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用没有注册 Scheduler 计划，而是使用私有 it-service-desk executor，符合指引。

requirementFit.reason: 每 15 分钟扫描、启动补扫、只提醒一次和关闭清理都由 jobs 库直接支持，应用装配与指引示例逐项对应。

usability.reason: addJob/setup/shutdown 三个入口清楚，every 单位与 execute 瘦身要求有明确说明；扣分点是 schedule 规则与业务幂等需要应用自己组合，示例未给出失败回退模式。

agentFriendliness.reason: services-and-jobs 指引给出与本应用几乎同形的 provider 示例，Scheduler Skill 又明确何时不该用 UI 调度，Agent 能直接选对 API。

design.reason: ScheduleExecutor 与 JobExecutor 分离，addJob 在 created 状态先挂起、setup 时统一 upsert 并开始消费，避免规则先触发而 handler 未注册；应用只需持有 executor 引用。

reliability.reason: 实现中 setup 幂等缓存、shutdown 幂等且不删除规则，pending 在 setup 时写入；应用按契约在 start/shutdown 调用，未发现生命周期遗漏。

modules.name: 截图上传与访问控制

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file
entrypoints: SKILL.md policy and public content route guidance

modules.scope: 截图文件集合、上传校验、提交时绑定工单、预览/下载内容路由，以及附件按工单可见性授权。
modules.limitations: 未实际上传文件或请求内容路由；未做图像预览的视觉判断。访问控制结论来自冻结路由代码、Policy 配置和文件 Skill 的明文约束。

requirements.need: 建立符合 File 契约的附件集合
requirements.responsibility: 框架规定固定 File 列与上传 Policy 派生规则；集合名和业务关联列由应用声明。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 Skill 在迁移中逐列声明 id/disk/key/filename/ext/mimeType/size/createdAt/updatedAt，再追加业务关联列。
requirements.actualUsage: itTicketFiles 前七列与 createdAt/updatedAt 完全按契约声明，另加 ticketId/uploadedById 和索引。

requirements.need: 只接受完整可解码的 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP，且不超过 5MB
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供上传大小/类型限制和 Policy；业务级字节完整性校验可由应用补充。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 exposure 的 maxSize/mime 限制并在提交时校验文件归属、大小和类型；需要更强校验时在应用侧读字节。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用在浏览器按 magic bytes、IEND/EOI 等结构校验并尝试解码，服务端再次检查归属、大小、image/* 和文件字节。

requirements.need: 附件只能被工单报修人、被分配工程师和服务台查看
requirements.responsibility: 文件插件的 API/内容路由默认公开，框架要求应用在自有路径上注册认证与授权；工单可见性规则属于应用。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 /<name>/<action> 与 <accessPath>/* 前加应用认证/授权，并按 operation 与记录/父记录 access 检查；不能只靠登录或 Policy 字段白名单。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用给元数据路由加了 authentication，但 read Policy 使用 read.scope: true；内容路由只有 authentication，没有按 ticketId/requesterId/assigneeId 的记录授权。

requirements.need: 上传后可预览和下载原图
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 stream/redirect 内容路由和附件下载语义；展示位置由应用决定。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 通过 accessPath/<uuid>.<ext> 读取内容，按磁盘能力选择 stream 或 redirect。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用生成 /api/it-ticket-files/content/<id> 路由并读取 drive 字节，客户端用该地址显示图片。

requirementFit.reason: File 契约、上传限制、内容读取和应用自有授权钩子都存在，但附件可见性只能靠应用额外实现中间件；本应用未做到，因此该需求在本次交付中仅以不安全方式满足。

usability.reason: 集合列与上传 Policy 派生规则清楚，但内容路由默认公开、授权完全由应用接管，接入者很容易只加 authentication 就以为完成；Skill 的警告在长文中不够显眼。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确写了 public 内容路由和逐路径加授权的做法，但缺少可直接照用的受限内容路由示例，Agent 最终只加了登录校验。

design.reason: FILE_COLUMNS 与 uploadPolicy 把上传路径的 Policy 收窄到服务端可写列，同时保留 create 的 scope/defaults，边界有明确注释；公开内容路由是刻意的首版设计，但把安全责任整体推给应用。

reliability.reason: 冻结实现中内容路由确实不经过 Policy，uploadPolicy 只放宽上传所需列且 create:false 仍拒绝上传；应用侧字节校验覆盖结构与解码，但访问控制实现未兑现指引要求。

findings.title: 非法用户名的错误没有指出允许的字符集
findings.detail: 认证 Skill 明确用户名只能是 3–30 位字母、数字、下划线或点，但 userAdministration.create 的 optionalUsername 只做 trim 和小写化，随后由 Better Auth 抛出不带约束说明的 APIError: Username is invalid。历史修复轮使用带连字符的 it-demo-service 等账号，样例数据测试因此整组失败，最终只能在应用侧改名绕行。
findings.impact: 调用方无法从错误判断是长度、字符集还是重名；Agent 需要阅读认证插件内部实现或反复试错，增加一轮修复成本，且同样的错误在其他应用中会重复出现。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 user-administration 的创建/更新路径按文档语法做前置校验，返回结构化 400（例如 USERNAME_INVALID，并说明允许的字符与长度）；或在捕获 Better Auth 的 username 校验错误时映射为同样的稳定错误。

diagnosis.trigger: 通过 userManagement.create 创建 username 为 it-demo-service 的账号（含连字符，不符合 Skill 的 3–30 位字母/数字/下划线/点规则）。
diagnosis.expected: 创建接口返回可定位的 400，说明用户名允许的字符集和长度；或创建前即拒绝并给出同一说明。
diagnosis.actual: user-administration 仅 trim/lowercase 后交给 Better Auth，最终日志只得到 APIError: Username is invalid，没有字段、字符集或长度信息。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用把演示账号改为 itdemo_service 等下划线形式，并同步调整测试和登录；框架侧未修复。
diagnosis.acceptance: 新增用例：创建含连字符或超长用户名时返回 400 且 message/字段错误码明确指出允许的 3–30 位字母、数字、下划线或点；合法用户名仍创建成功。

evidence.excerpt: Sample data goes in the same `seeds` directory, declared with `defineSeed({ name, sample: true, run })`. It runs only when the application installs its database with `app.sampleData` set (`APP_SAMPLE_DATA=true`): the connection held no migration or seed history before that start, or `db reset` rebuilt it. Otherwise the seed is recorded as skipped and never runs on its own; `pnpm nocobase db sample` runs every skipped sample seed in development, and a deployment refuses it. Sample data that has to go through other plugins' services, such as projects with issues, is registered instead on `sampleDataToken` from `@nocobase/app-server/sample-data`, from a service provider's `boot()`: `container.resolve(sampleDataToken).register({ name, packageName, run })`. It runs once the application is ready, under the same condition, and is recorded in the default connection's seed history as `sample-data:<name>`. The seed history's `status` column, `executed` or `skipped`, records which happened; the library adds it to an existing history table on the next run.

evidence.excerpt:
1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable composite, page and data scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable collection permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing business operations as composite resources with `defineCompositeResource` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every collection a workflow touches.
3. In the owning provider's `boot`, opt collections in with `authz.database.collections.add`, register composites with `authz.compositeResources.define`, record access with `authz.recordAccess.define` and settings items with `authz.settings.add`. Then add a workspace subsection with `authz.ui.sections.add({ name, title, parent })` and list each composite or settings item in it with `authz.ui.place(reference, { section, group? })` (the permission workspace lists sections and subsections on the left and the selected subsection's resources, under optional `authz.ui.groups`, on the right; an unplaced composite or settings item goes under its default section's Other with a startup warning, and a misplaced one fails a development start). Pages are not registered on the server: the client route tree lists them. Release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, keep `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.database.authorizeRepository` to map methods to composite actions; it reuses or initializes the request's authorization context. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple data scopes or custom responses, install `authz.middleware()`, call `c.get('authz').authorize()` once and bind every returned collection policy with `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Declare `authz` on every entry client route (nested pages inherit it; an omitted one defaults to root-only or `'skip'` with a development warning), add `useCan` for action visibility and obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending and error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page and action grants, selected data scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; editing a seed does not update a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.

evidence.excerpt: Before the first seed run, set `users.initialAdmin.username`, `users.initialAdmin.email` and `users.initialAdmin.password` in application configuration to customize the bootstrap account. Omitting the entire node preserves `nocobase` / `admin@nocobase.com` / `admin123`; an explicit node requires a nonempty password and defaults the username to `nocobase` and the email to `admin@nocobase.com`. Usernames contain 3–30 letters, digits, underscores or dots, emails must be valid addresses, and both are stored lowercase. Initialization only runs when the user table is empty, hashes the password and grants the newly created account root permission through the authorization plugin. After initialization, configuration changes do not reset accounts or rerun the recorded seeds. The root permission seed selects the administrator by the same configured username. Use the user administration service for subsequent account changes. Do not edit historical seeds or add a competing administrator seed.

  `@nocobase/app-plugin-users/server/tokens`.
- HTTP API: `GET /api/users` (`page`, `pageSize`, `q`, `status`, `roleScope`, `role`; answers `{ data, meta: { page, pageSize, total } }`), `GET /api/users/options`, `POST /api/users`, `PATCH /api/users/:userId`, `DELETE /api/users/:userId?confirm=true`, `POST /api/users/:userId/disable|enable|resetPassword|revokeSessions`, and `PUT /api/users/:userId/roleScopes/:scope`. The running application documents each one, with request and response schemas, at `/api/swagger/docs` (JSON at `/api/swagger`) under the `Users` tag. Failures use the standard error body; branch on `error.reason`, such as `USER_NOT_FOUND`, `SELF_DELETE_NOT_ALLOWED`, `LAST_ASSIGNMENT` or `USER_EMAIL_CONFLICT`.

Every HTTP route requires Authentication and Authorization. Routes check the `user` record type with one of `read`, `create`, `update`, `disable`, `enable`, `assign-role`, `reset-password`, `revoke-sessions` or `delete`. Account creation checks both `create` and `assign-role`. `delete` is permitted only while an application role scope can clean a deleted user up.

1. Register Authentication, Authorization, and then Users in the App's Client
   and Server plugin arrays. The Client factory takes no placement options:
   `users()`.

evidence.excerpt:
`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata — decided, with the principal, before the body limit, the content type or the multipart body is read, so a refused upload answers `403 WRITE_FORBIDDEN` (domain `app`) and stores nothing — and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

# agent-browser core

Fast browser automation CLI for AI agents. Chrome/Chromium via CDP, no Playwright or Puppeteer dependency. Accessibility-tree snapshots with compact `@eN` refs let agents interact with pages in ~200-400 tokens instead of parsing raw HTML.

Most normal web tasks (navigate, read, click, fill, extract, screenshot) are covered here. Load a specialized skill when the task falls outside browser web pages — see [When to load another skill](#when-to-load-another-skill).

## The core loop

```bash
agent-browser open <url>        # 1. Open a page
agent-browser snapshot -i       # 2. See what's on it (interactive elements only)
agent-browser click @e3         # 3. Act on refs from the snapshot
agent-browser snapshot -i       # 4. Re-snapshot after any page change
```

Refs (`@e1`, `@e2`, ...) are assigned fresh on every snapshot. They become **stale the moment the page changes** — after clicks that navigate, form submits, dynamic re-renders, dialog opens. Always re-snapshot before your next ref interaction.

## Always use your own session

Before your first command, set a named session for the whole task:

```bash
export AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION="$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task)"
```

The default (unnamed) session is a single shared browser: it is shared with every other agent on the machine and it persists across conversations, so working in it can hijack another agent's page mid-task or navigate away from something the human left open. Every example below assumes a named session is active. See [Run multiple browsers in parallel](#run-multiple-browsers-in-parallel) and `references/session-management.md`.

## Quickstart

```bash
# Install once

# Linux hosts can install required browser libraries too

# Search, click a result, and capture it

agent-browser snapshot -i                      # find the search box ref
agent-browser fill @e1 "agent-browser cli"
agent-browser press Enter
agent-browser wait --load networkidle
agent-browser snapshot -i                      # refs now reflect results
agent-browser click @e5                        # click a result
agent-browser screenshot result.png
```

The browser stays running across commands so these feel like a single session. By default, an inactive daemon saves configured restore state, closes its headless browser, and exits after one hour; the next command starts it again.
